summary: P0 implemented ADR helper foundation: stdlib-only adr_records.py, directory discovery, slug/number allocation, Markdown render/parse, isolated tests, and package script check coverage.

P1 completed ADR graph validation/currentness and compact lookup: read/write graph JSONL, validate action, list/query/show current-first summaries, legacy receipt exceptions, stale dependency warnings, private-reference rejection, and focused tests.

P2 completed ADR evaluate, draft, create, write, relate, and import flows. Standalone/manual ADRs can be created without .plan topics; workflow drafts require passed receipts; legacy imports can omit receipts with explicit markers.

P3 added the cartographer_adr extension tool, argument mapping for ADR CLI actions, prompt guidance separating ADR management from low-level JSONL utilities, and TypeScript tests for registration and execution.

P4 added ADR gate guidance to proposal/plan workflows: evaluate with cartographer_adr, record adr_required metadata, prompt for alternatives/rationale on directed architecture choices, and remove stale blanket out-of-scope ADR wording.

P5 integrated ADR finalization into implement workflow after validation: required ADR draft/write/validate, adr-not-required receipts for skips, evidence contract with receipts/commits, and stop rules for ambiguous metadata.

P6 updated README/index docs for ADR support, documented ADR modes and docs/adr structure, and added tests proving ADR Markdown is retrievable via the index while ADR graph lookup stays with cartographer_adr.
P7 completed final validation and dogfooded ADR generation. User approved creating docs/adr/0001-record-adr-management-workflow.md, ADR graph JSONL validates, and full project checks passed.
